title: MES Engineer
summary: Sets up and extends manufacturing execution systems (MES), the software that runs production orders, tracks parts and records quality on the factory floor. Sits between plant IT, the ERP team and automation engineers, linking machines and PLCs below with ERP systems such as SAP above.
dailyDuties: Configure MES models, routes and work instructions
Write extensions and reports in C# or Java and SQL
Build interfaces between MES and SAP or other ERP
Connect PLCs and SCADA to MES through OPC UA
Gather requirements from production and quality teams
Support go-lives and fix plant issues during hypercare

skills.expectation: Configure and extend an MES such as Opcenter, FactoryTalk, AVEVA MES or SAP DM
Model plants on ISA-95 and integrate MES with ERP and shop-floor systems
Write SQL queries, stored procedures and reports on the MES database
Connect PLCs, SCADA and historians to MES, often via OPC UA
Write MES extensions and services in C#, Java or JavaScript
Write MES extensions and services in C#, Java or JavaScript
Write MES extensions and services in C#, Java or JavaScript
Gather requirements from production, quality and IT teams
Exchange production orders and confirmations with SAP via IDocs or BAPIs
Understand SAP production orders and routings on the ERP side
Build OEE and downtime reports from MES data
Build and consume REST APIs for MES integration
Work with SCADA platforms that feed the MES
Coordinate plant, IT and vendor teams during rollouts

certifications.why: Helps when the MES integrates with SAP production planning
